text:
Race week in Baku. The Azerbaijan GP is on Saturday this weekend, rather than the usual Sunday.

Thursday 24 September: practice begins
Friday 25 September: qualifying
Saturday 26 September: race

Race start: 15:00 Baku / 11:00 UTC.

metadata.altText: Race week Baku poster in chartreuse and charcoal, showing the old city walls and Flame Towers. 24–26 September 2026: Thu 24 Practice, Fri 25 Qualifying, Sat 26 Race. Saturday's race is highlighted. grandprixpicks.com appears at the bottom.
